reviewedTitle.en: Liu Bang · Building a winning coalition
reviewedTitle.zh: 刘邦 · 建立能够取胜的联盟

reviewedSummary.en: Liu Bang's rise began in local office and rebellion, not in an established royal court. The Shiji follows his force from Pei into Qin's heartland and then through a war in which allies repeatedly changed sides. Victory required commanders, supplies and agreements about who would receive conquered territory. Zhang Liang's advice and Han Xin's campaigns belonged to that larger coalition. In 202 BCE Liu Bang became emperor and shifted his political center toward the Chang'an region. The settlement combined imperial administration with kingdoms granted to powerful allies and relatives. Subsequent conflict over those kingdoms shows that founding the Han dynasty was a continuing negotiation over power, rather than a single moment when conquest became stable government.
reviewedSummary.zh: 刘邦的崛起始于地方职务和起兵，而非现成的王室宫廷。《史记》记述他从沛县进入秦的腹地，随后卷入一场盟友不断改换阵营的战争。取胜需要将领、供给，也需要对征服所得作出分配承诺。张良的谋划与韩信的战役，都是这一大联盟的组成部分。前202年，刘邦称帝，并将政治中心转向长安地区。新秩序把帝国行政与分封给功臣、宗亲的王国结合起来。围绕这些王国的后续冲突表明，汉朝的建立是一场持续的权力协商，而非征服突然变成稳定统治的单一时刻。

reviewedTitle.en: Emperor Wu of Han · Expansion and the price of empire
reviewedTitle.zh: 汉武帝 · 扩张与帝国的代价

reviewedSummary.en: Emperor Wu expanded the ambitions of the Han court. Campaigns against the Xiongnu, western embassies and new territorial administrations drew distant societies into changing relations with the empire. At home, the court sponsored classical learning and reorganized ritual authority. These projects required resources. Sima Qian's fiscal history follows the burdens of transport, military rewards and revenue gathering, providing a counterpoint to accounts of imperial achievement. The reign also ended amid violent court conflict, including accusations of witchcraft that destroyed the crown prince's position. His history is therefore best read across institutions and households as well as campaigns: the same government that extended connections could impose heavy demands on those who supplied its soldiers, officials and ceremonies.
reviewedSummary.zh: 汉武帝扩大了汉廷的政治抱负。对匈奴的战争、向西派遣使团和新设地方行政，使远方社会与帝国建立了不断变化的关系。国内则扶持经典学习，重整祭祀权威。这些行动都需要资源。司马迁的财政史追踪运输、军功赏赐和筹集收入带来的负担，为帝国功业叙事提供另一面。晚年宫廷还发生激烈冲突，巫蛊指控最终摧毁了太子的地位。因此，理解这一时期不能只看战役，还要看制度与家庭：扩展联系的同一个政权，也可能向供养军队、官吏和礼仪的人们提出沉重要求。

reviewedTitle.en: Xuanzong: a court of poets and a reign in crisis

reviewedSummary.en: Xuanzong’s reign is associated with the flourishing poetry, painting and court culture of the High Tang. Chang’an connected officials and artists with merchants, clerics and envoys from across Asia. Li Bai, Wang Wei and Du Fu nevertheless experienced that world from different social positions; a celebrated cultural era was not one shared biography. The rebellion beginning in 755 brought the court’s vulnerabilities into view and soon ended Xuanzong’s reign. The Tang itself survived. Reading his reign alongside the poems and mourning texts of its subjects moves beyond a tale of court splendor followed by collapse, revealing how cultural work continued through displacement and political change.
reviewedSummary.zh: 玄宗在位时期常与盛唐诗歌、绘画及宫廷文化的兴盛相联系。长安使官员、艺术家与来自亚洲各地的商人、僧侣、使者相遇。但李白、王维、杜甫在这一世界中的社会位置并不相同，一个著名的文化时代也不是所有人共同的人生。755年爆发的叛乱暴露了朝廷的脆弱，随后结束了玄宗的统治，唐朝本身却继续存在。把他的在位时期与臣民留下的诗歌、祭文相对读，可以看见流离和政治变化中的文化创作，而不只是一条由繁华直落覆亡的叙事。

reviewedTitle.en: Li Jing: campaigns that enlarged early Tang power

reviewedSummary.en: Li Jing’s career connects the wars that established Tang rule with campaigns beyond its northern and western frontiers. In 621 he helped defeat Xiao Xian’s regime around Jiangling. His forces later struck the Eastern Turkic leadership, contributing to its defeat in 630, and campaigned against Tuyuhun in 635. These were collective military operations involving other commanders, allied forces and defeated communities. Li Jing also held senior posts at court, where military achievement could become political authority. Later generations attached strategic wisdom to his name, but the campaigns can be studied without assuming that every military text attributed to him was actually his work.
reviewedSummary.zh: 李靖的仕途把唐朝建立统治的战争，与其后向北方、西方拓展的战事联系起来。621年，他参与击败以江陵为中心的萧铣政权；630年，其军队打击东突厥统治者，参与东突厥的败亡；635年又出征吐谷浑。这些行动涉及其他将领、协同部队以及战败地区的社会，不能归结为一人的功业。李靖也在朝廷担任要职，军事成就因此转化为政治权威。后世把兵学智慧附着在他的名字上，但研究具体战事，并不需要预先认定所有托名兵书都出自其手。

reviewedTitle.en: Yan Zhenqing: public duty and private mourning

reviewedSummary.en: Yan Zhenqing’s calligraphy preserves more than an admired style. The draft he wrote in 758 for his nephew Yan Jiming recalls deaths in his family during the An–Shi rebellion. Corrections and additions make the work a record of writing under the pressure of grief, as well as a text shaped by loyalty to the Tang. Another surviving letter, assigned by scholars to about 775, belongs to a less ceremonial world of communication. These works place an official’s handwriting between public responsibility and personal need. They also invite different kinds of reading: the dated mourning text anchors an event, while the letter’s date depends on historical comparison.

reviewedTitle.en: Liu Zongyuan: exile, landscape and obligations

reviewedSummary.en: Liu Zongyuan passed the jinshi examination in 793 and joined an ambitious circle of reforming officials. Its defeat in 805 sent him to Yongzhou in a marginal post. The political setback became the setting for essays, fables and landscape writing that continue to invite readers into questions of power and perception. His descriptions of small, overlooked places gave literary attention to terrain beyond the capital. Appointment as prefect of Liuzhou in 815 restored more active administrative responsibilities, but he died there in 819. His career belongs beside Han Yu’s in the development of classical prose, while their writings offer different approaches to politics, philosophy and religious life.
reviewedSummary.zh: 柳宗元793年进士及第，后来加入试图改革政务的官员群体。805年革新失败后，他被贬永州，担任边缘性的官职。政治挫折成为散文、寓言与山水游记的写作背景，作品不断引导读者思考权力与观察方式。他描写不起眼的地点，使都城之外的地形进入文学视野。815年出任柳州刺史，使他重新承担较积极的行政职责，但819年便卒于当地。他与韩愈的经历共同构成古文发展的背景，两人的写作对政治、哲学和宗教生活又有不同回应。

reviewedTitle.en: Wang Yangming: moral knowledge tested in action
reviewedTitle.zh: 王阳明：在行动中检验道德认识

reviewedSummary.en: Wang Yangming, also known as Wang Shouren, passed the highest civil examination in 1499. Punishment in 1506 sent him toward exile in Guizhou, where the insight associated with 1508 became a turning point in his philosophical account. He argued that moral knowing was not merely information stored before action: genuine understanding and conduct belonged together. His emphasis on innate moral awareness also challenged a learning practice centered only on accumulating external knowledge. Return to office brought military and administrative responsibilities, keeping his philosophy close to questions of public action. The resulting tradition asks a practical question: what does someone truly know if that knowledge leaves their conduct untouched?
reviewedSummary.zh: 王阳明本名王守仁，1499年通过最高级文官考试。1506年受罚后，他被贬往贵州；与1508年相联系的悟道，成为其思想历程的转折。他主张道德认识并非行动前储存的一套信息，真实理解与行为本来相连。对内在良知的重视，也挑战了只向外积累知识的学习方式。重返仕途后，军事和行政职责使其哲学持续接触公共行动的问题。由此形成的思想传统提出一个切实追问：如果某种知识丝毫不改变人的行为，究竟能说已经懂得了什么？

reviewedTitle.en: Wang Anshi: turning a diagnosis into policy
reviewedTitle.zh: 王安石：从诊断问题到制定政策

reviewedSummary.en: Wang Anshi brought experience in local administration to a program that made government responsible for changing economic conditions. His 1069 memorial on crop loans described the difficulty farmers faced between harvests and proposed public credit alongside grain management. The argument treated expensive private borrowing as a problem that institutions could address. It was a proposal, however, not a report proving that every borrower benefited. Opponents including Sima Guang disputed the direction and methods of reform. Wang’s withdrawal to Jiangning in 1076 ended one phase of political leadership, while the controversy continued. His career invites readers to connect a policy’s stated purpose with the officials, information and coercive power needed to carry it out.
reviewedSummary.zh: 王安石把地方行政经验带入改革计划，主张政府主动改变经济条件。1069年的青苗奏议描述农民在收获之间面临的困难，提出以公共信贷配合粮食管理，把高成本私人借贷视为制度能够处理的问题。但奏议表达的是主张，并非证明每个借款者都受益的成效报告。司马光等反对者质疑改革的方向和方法。1076年退居江宁，结束了其政治领导的一个阶段，争论却继续存在。他的经历引导读者把政策目标与执行所需的官员、信息和强制力联系起来。

reviewedTitle.en: Xie An · Keeping a court together in crisis

reviewedSummary.en: Xie An's reputation for cultivated withdrawal did not keep him outside government. After years among literary companions around Kuaiji, he entered service and became central to the Eastern Jin court. His task involved balancing the imperial family, powerful ministers and commanders with regional bases. When Former Qin invaded in 383, Xie Shi, Xie Xuan and other generals fought the campaign while Xie An coordinated from the political center. The Jinshu's famous story of his calm reaction to victory is a crafted portrait of composure, not a direct view into his thoughts. Rivalries persisted after the danger passed. His career shows that preserving a regime required managing relationships as well as winning a battle.
reviewedSummary.zh: 谢安以退隐风雅著称，却并未始终置身政治之外。他早年在会稽一带与文人交游，后来出仕，逐渐成为东晋朝廷的核心人物。他需要在皇族、权臣和拥有地方军力的将领之间维持平衡。383年前秦入侵时，谢石、谢玄等将领在前线作战，谢安则在政治中心协调。《晋书》中得胜仍从容下棋的著名故事，是塑造镇定形象的叙事，并非对其内心的直接观察。危机解除后，权力竞争仍在继续。他的经历说明，维持政权既需要战场胜利，也需要处理人与人之间的关系。

reviewedTitle.en: Li Cunxu · a dynasty built through personal loyalties

reviewedSummary.en: Li Cunxu inherited his father Li Keyong’s position as Prince of Jin in 908 and proclaimed the Later Tang in 923. His regime drew on the Tang name while adapting institutions to the world of competing northern armies. Military households mattered as much as formal offices. Adopted sons and experienced commanders brought networks of loyalty that could strengthen a ruler and also resist him. Historian Richard L. Davis traces such tensions between Cunxu and his adoptive brother Li Siyuan. Conquest did not settle their political relationship. Cunxu died in a soldiers’ mutiny in 926, after only a short imperial reign, making his career a study in the difficult passage from coalition warfare to government.

reviewedTitle.en: Xiaowen: moving a court, changing its language

reviewedSummary.en: Emperor Xiaowen ruled a Northern Wei court shaped by Tuoba traditions and the institutions of the people it governed. Moving the capital from Pingcheng to Luoyang in 493–494 made that negotiation visible in geography. Changes in language, dress and court practice accompanied the move; adopting Chinese forms did not simply erase the dynasty’s earlier history. Buddhist patronage supplied another language of authority. At Longmen, sculpture drew on connections between northern and southern artistic traditions. His reign thus links political decisions to the lives of officials, craftspeople and worshippers who inhabited an increasingly interconnected cultural world.
reviewedSummary.zh: 孝文帝统治的北魏朝廷，既承袭拓跋传统，也面对被统治地区已有的制度。493—494年由平城迁往洛阳，使这种调整落实在都城的选择上。语言、服饰和朝廷礼制的变化伴随迁都展开；采用汉文化形式，并不意味着此前的王朝历史被抹去。佛教赞助提供了另一种表达权威的方式。龙门石窟的造像体现南北艺术传统之间的联系。通过这一时期，可以把政治决策与官员、工匠、礼佛者的生活联系起来，观察制度和艺术如何共同参与文化的变化。

reviewedTitle.en: Wang Wei: a landscape made in words
reviewedTitle.zh: 王维：以文字营造山水

reviewedSummary.en: Wang Wei moved between official service, literary friendship and the imagined stillness of landscape. His examination success is conventionally dated to 721, although the sequence of his early career remains debated. Around 740 he acquired the Wangchuan estate, whose named sites became the subjects of twenty short poems. These poems invite attention to a changing view, a sound, or a moment when a place seems empty of people. His reputation as a painter extended that conversation between seeing and composing. The paintings now associated with Wangchuan are later versions, however; their relationship to a lost Tang work is part of the history of his reception, not proof of what his own brush produced.
reviewedSummary.zh: 王维在仕宦、文人交游与山水中想象的静境之间往返。进士及第通常系于721年，但早年经历的先后仍有讨论。约740年购得辋川别业后，他以其中有名称的地点写成二十首短诗，引人留意视角的变化、某种声响或仿佛无人之境。他作为画家的声誉，使观看与写作之间的关系继续延伸。然而，今天与辋川联系起来的画卷是后世版本；它们与已佚唐代作品的关系，属于王维接受史的一部分，不能直接证明他亲笔绘画的面貌。

evidence.en: Detail of Wang Yuanqi’s Wangchuan Villa, 1711, revisiting the landscape associated with Wang Wei’s poems.
evidence.zh: 王原祁1711年《辋川图》局部，重访与王维诗歌相连的景观。

reviewedTitle.en: Bai Qi · Conquest and its human cost
reviewedTitle.zh: 白起 · 征服及其代价

reviewedSummary.en: Bai Qi helped turn Qin's military strength into territorial expansion. The Shiji follows him from victories against Han and Wei to the capture of Chu's capital, Ying, and the defeat of Zhao at Changping. These were campaigns that damaged rival states' ability to resist Qin, but their history also includes the killing of surrendered soldiers. Ancient casualty totals are not dependable counts; the violence itself remains central to the account. Bai Qi's final conflict was with his own court. He resisted another attack on Zhao, lost royal favor and was ordered to die. His career shows the insecurity of a commander whose victories increased both the ruler's power and dependence on him.
reviewedSummary.zh: 白起把秦国的军事力量转化为领土扩张。《史记》记载他击败韩、魏，攻取楚都郢，又在长平击败赵军。这些战役削弱了诸侯抵抗秦国的能力，其中也包括对投降士卒的杀戮。古书中的伤亡数字不能当作可靠统计，但暴力本身不能从叙述中删去。白起最后面对的冲突来自本国宫廷。他反对继续进攻赵国，随后失去君主信任，被命令自尽。他的经历说明：将领的胜利既增强国君权势，也可能让双方的依赖与猜忌同时加深。

evidence.en: Anonymous Ming-dynasty portrait of Bai Qi, titled Lord Wu’an of Qin.
evidence.zh: 明代佚名白起像，题名“秦武安君白起”。

reviewedTitle.en: Li Mu · Protecting a state under pressure
reviewedTitle.zh: 李牧 · 守护危局中的赵国

reviewedSummary.en: Li Mu's biography begins with a different image of military skill: keeping soldiers and herds safe by refusing unnecessary battle. On Zhao's northern frontier, the Shiji credits him with disciplined defenses, attention to supplies and training, and protection of agriculture and pastoral life. Later he fought Yan and helped resist Qin as Zhao's position deteriorated. The same narrative explains his removal through court intrigue and Qin's bribery of a royal favorite. That account exposes the historian's interest in the relationship between rulers and capable servants, as well as recording Zhao's crisis. Li Mu was killed before the final capture of Zhao's king. His unknown birth date and the undated frontier anecdotes should not become a fabricated itinerary.
reviewedSummary.zh: 李牧传记开篇呈现了另一种军事能力：通过避免无谓交战，保护士卒与牲畜。《史记》称他在赵国北部边地整顿防御，重视供给、训练，并维护农牧生产。后来他攻燕，又在赵国局势恶化时抵御秦军。同一传记用宫廷离间和秦国贿赂宠臣来解释他的被罢免；这既记录赵国危机，也表现史家对君臣关系的关注。李牧在赵王最终被俘之前遭杀害。他的出生年不详，北疆故事也缺少确切年份，不能把这些材料拼成看似完整的行程。

evidence.en: Anonymous Qing-dynasty portrait of the Zhao commander Li Mu.
evidence.zh: 清代佚名赵将李牧像。

reviewedTitle.en: Wang Jian · The resources behind conquest
reviewedTitle.zh: 王翦 · 征服背后的资源

reviewedSummary.en: Wang Jian commanded several of the campaigns that brought Qin's rivals under imperial rule. His biography makes victory depend on resources and political trust as much as battlefield daring. In the account of the Chu campaign, a smaller expedition failed before the king accepted Wang Jian's demand for a much larger force. The general then delayed battle while preparing his army. Stories about his repeated requests for estates underline the tension between a ruler and a commander entrusted with enormous power. He also campaigned against Zhao and Yan. Distinguishing Wang Jian from his son Wang Ben matters: later summaries can collapse different commanders and campaigns into one effortless march toward unification.
reviewedSummary.zh: 王翦统率了秦兼并诸侯过程中的多次重要战役。他的传记把胜利与资源、政治信任联系起来，并不只强调临阵勇武。伐楚的叙事先写较小规模的远征失败，随后秦王才接受王翦增兵的要求；王翦又通过等待和准备选择作战时机。他反复请求田宅的故事，表现了国君与掌握大军的将领之间的紧张关系。他还参与攻赵、攻燕。把王翦与其子王贲区分开来很有必要，否则不同将领和战役容易被压缩成一场毫无阻力的统一进程。

evidence.en: Anonymous Ming-dynasty portrait, inscribed Great General Wang Jian of Qin.
evidence.zh: 明代佚名画像，题名“秦大将军王翦”。

reviewedTitle.en: Chai Rong · campaigns and the resources of rule
reviewedTitle.zh: 柴荣 · 征战与统治资源

reviewedSummary.en: Chai Rong, adopted into Guo Wei’s household, became ruler of the Later Zhou in 954. His short reign joined military expansion with decisions about the resources available to government. The annals record temple closures and restrictions on copper in 955, then campaigns against Southern Tang. By 958 the southern campaign had established the Yangtze as the boundary between the two states. These changes affected religious institutions, local revenues and populations caught between armies. A northern campaign followed in 959, but Chai Rong died that year and a child succeeded him. His reign deserves attention as a political project in its own right, rather than merely a preface to the later Song.
reviewedSummary.zh: 柴荣幼年进入郭威家中并被收为养子，954年成为后周君主。他短暂的统治将军事扩张与国家资源安排联系在一起。本纪记载955年的裁并寺院、铜禁，以及随后对南唐的征战。至958年，南方战事使双方以长江为界。这些变化影响了宗教机构、地方收入与处于军队之间的民众。959年柴荣又率军北上，却在当年去世，由幼子继位。他的统治具有自身的政治目标，不应仅被写成后来宋朝建立的前奏。

evidence.en: Anonymous Qing-dynasty portrait of Chai Rong, ruler of Later Zhou.
evidence.zh: 清代佚名后周世宗柴荣像。

reviewedTitle.en: Liu Yu · Restoration becomes a new dynasty
reviewedTitle.zh: 刘裕 · 恢复旧朝与建立新朝

reviewedSummary.en: Liu Yu first built his authority as a commander acting in the name of the Eastern Jin. In 404 his coalition rose against Huan Xuan and recovered the capital for the displaced dynasty. Subsequent campaigns increased his control over soldiers, appointments and territory. In 417 his generals captured Chang'an and ended Later Qin, but the northern gains proved difficult to hold after he returned east. The surviving history records the loss of the region in the following year. In 420 Liu Yu replaced the Jin emperor and founded the Liu-Song dynasty. The language of restoration had become the language of dynastic succession. His record connects military achievement with the problem of turning a personal command into a governing house.
reviewedSummary.zh: 刘裕最初以东晋名义统兵，逐渐建立权势。404年，他与盟友起兵反对桓玄，为被取代的晋朝夺回都城。此后的战役扩大了他对军队、官职与土地的控制。417年，麾下将领攻取长安，结束后秦，但他东归后，北方所得难以守住，史书记载次年关中失守。420年，刘裕取代晋帝，建立刘宋。恢复旧朝的语言转成了王朝更替的语言。他的经历将军事成就与另一道难题联系起来：如何把个人统兵的权力转为一个统治家族的制度。

evidence.en: Anonymous Qing-dynasty portrait of Liu Yu, founder of Liu Song.
evidence.zh: 清代佚名刘宋开国君主刘裕像。

reviewedTitle.en: Fu Jian · conquest and a coalition’s limits
reviewedTitle.zh: 苻坚 · 征服与联盟的限度

reviewedSummary.en: Fu Jian became ruler of Former Qin in 357 and built an expanding state around Chang’an. Working with Wang Meng and other advisers, he combined military conquest with offices, schooling and the incorporation of defeated elites. The conquest of Former Yan in 370 brought new territory and people, including families moved into the Guanzhong region. Expansion also produced a difficult problem: armies and leaders incorporated by conquest did not necessarily share a lasting political commitment. In 383 Fu Jian attacked Eastern Jin and suffered defeat at the Fei River. The dynastic histories frame the disaster as a ruler ignoring advice; their account also exposes the strains of governing a large, recently assembled realm.
reviewedSummary.zh: 苻坚于357年成为前秦统治者，以长安为中心扩张国家。他与王猛等谋臣合作，将军事征服同官制、学校及接纳战败精英结合起来。370年灭前燕后，新的领土与人口进入其统治，其中一些家族被迁往关中。扩张也带来难题：征服所纳入的军队和领袖未必具有持久的政治认同。383年，苻坚进攻东晋，在淝水战败。正史将灾难归结为君主不听劝谏；这些叙述也揭示了治理一个刚刚拼合的大国所承受的压力。

evidence.en: Named portrait of Fu Jian in Xiuxiang Sanguo Yanyi Xubian, volume 1, Shanghai, 1893.
evidence.zh: 《绣像三国演义续编》卷一中的苻坚像，上海，1893年。

reviewedTitle.en: Huan Wen · campaigns and pressure on the court
reviewedTitle.zh: 桓温 · 征战与朝廷压力

reviewedSummary.en: Huan Wen’s conquest of Cheng-Han in 347 made him a powerful figure within the Eastern Jin. Control of regional armies allowed a commander far from the capital to influence decisions at court. Northern campaigns brought both achievement and frustration: the expedition of 369 ran short of supplies and ended in defeat. Huan then intervened directly in the succession, deposing an emperor in 371. The Book of Jin presents his ambition through ominous stories and moral judgment, but its account also reveals a structural tension between the dynasty and the armies defending it. His death in 373 left that tension unresolved; the imperial title had survived an extraordinarily powerful minister.
reviewedSummary.zh: 347年灭成汉之役使桓温成为东晋权势人物。控制地方军队，让一位远离首都的统帅能够影响宫廷决策。北伐既有进展，也有挫折：369年的远征因补给不足而以失败告终。随后，桓温直接干预皇位继承，于371年废立皇帝。《晋书》借预兆故事与道德评价描述其野心，但叙述背后也呈现出一种结构性矛盾：王朝依靠军队自卫，又受到统军者的威胁。373年桓温去世时，这一矛盾仍未解决；皇位则经历了强臣掌权而继续存在。

evidence.en: Huan Wen in Xiuxiang Sanguo Yanyi Xubian, volume 1, digital page 43, 1893.
evidence.zh: 《绣像三国演义续编》卷一桓温像，数字页43，1893年。

reviewedTitle.en: Li Yu · a lost court and a lyric voice
reviewedTitle.zh: 李煜 · 失去的宫廷与词中声音

reviewedSummary.en: Li Yu inherited Southern Tang in 961, ruling from Jinling within an increasingly constrained relationship with the Song. His court cultivated literature, calligraphy and painting, yet cultural activity did not secure political independence. Song armies took the capital in 975, and Li Yu was brought to Kaifeng. He died in 978. His lasting reputation rests on ci, lyrics composed to established musical patterns. Their images of separation, remembered pleasure and irreversible loss helped make political displacement emotionally legible. Reading these works alongside the annals brings together two kinds of evidence: a victor’s history of a defeated ruler and poetry whose speaking voice cannot always be treated as a literal diary.
reviewedSummary.zh: 961年，李煜在金陵继承南唐，在与宋朝日益受限的关系中执政。宫廷培养文学、书法与绘画，但文化活动无法保障政治独立。975年宋军攻取都城，李煜被带往开封，978年去世。他流传至今的声名主要来自按既有曲调填写的词。离别、旧日欢愉与无可挽回的失落，使政治上的流离获得可感的情绪。将词与本纪并读，便能看到两类证据：胜利者对亡国之君的历史叙述，以及不能一概当作逐日自传的诗歌声音。

evidence.en: Li Yu, the Southern Tang ruler and poet, in the Sancai Tuhui, 1609, volume 23.
evidence.zh: 南唐后主、词人李煜，《三才图会》卷23，1609年。

reviewedTitle.en: Xie Xuan · defence and the work of supply
reviewedTitle.zh: 谢玄 · 防御与补给工作

reviewedSummary.en: Xie Xuan’s appointment to command north of the Yangtze in 377 linked the influence of the Xie family at court with the practical defence of Eastern Jin. His forces helped defeat Fu Jian’s invasion at the Fei River in 383, alongside other commanders whose roles the dynastic history also records. Victory opened an opportunity to advance north. The next phase required more than battlefield success: the biography describes improving waterways to move supplies through difficult terrain. These works supported the campaign into the Yellow River region. Xie Xuan’s story makes logistics visible within a celebrated victory and shows how defence, expansion and transport could become parts of the same military undertaking.
reviewedSummary.zh: 377年谢玄受命统辖江北军务，将谢氏在朝廷的影响力与东晋防御的实际需要联系起来。383年，他与其他将领共同在淝水击败苻坚的进攻；正史也记录了这些同僚的作用。胜利提供了北进机会，但下一阶段所需的不只有战场胜绩。传记写到谢玄改善水道，使补给能够通过困难地形，支持向黄河地区推进。谢玄的故事让著名胜利背后的后勤工作显现出来，也说明防御、扩张与运输如何成为同一军事行动的组成部分。

evidence.en: Anonymous Qing-dynasty portrait titled Xie Xuan, Duke Xianwu of Kangle.
evidence.zh: 清代佚名画像，题名“晋康乐献武公谢玄”。

reviewedTitle.en: Guan Yu · Loyalty and a contested frontier
reviewedTitle.zh: 关羽 · 忠诚与争夺中的边地

reviewedSummary.en: Guan Yu's recorded career was shaped by divided loyalties and the strategic importance of Jingzhou. Captured by Cao Cao in 200, he served briefly in Cao's army and killed Yan Liang at Baima before returning to Liu Bei. Later he commanded the territory left behind when Liu Bei established himself in the west. His offensive toward Fancheng in 219 gained an unexpected advantage when floods overwhelmed an opposing army. Yet Sun Quan's forces struck at his rear, took Jiangling and broke his army's cohesion. Guan Yu was captured and killed. The surviving biography supplies a compact history of service, military success and collapse; famous scenes from later storytelling should not silently replace that sequence.
reviewedSummary.zh: 关羽的文献生涯与效忠对象的变化、荆州的战略地位紧密相连。200年，他被曹操俘获，短暂为其作战，在白马杀颜良，随后返回刘备身边。刘备在西方建立根据地后，关羽负责留下的荆州地区。219年进攻樊城时，洪水冲垮敌军，使他一度取得优势。然而孙权军袭击后方，夺取江陵，瓦解了其部队的凝聚力。关羽最终被俘并遭杀害。传世列传提供的是一段紧凑的效力、胜利与崩溃史，后世讲述中的著名场景不应在没有说明的情况下代替这一顺序。

evidence.zh: 《三才图会》卷25第42叶中的关羽后世像，1609年。

reviewedTitle.en: Zhang Fei · service, command and harsh discipline
reviewedTitle.zh: 张飞 · 从军、统率与严酷纪律

reviewedSummary.en: Zhang Fei’s biography presents a long association with Liu Bei and Guan Yu, built through shared military service. It credits him with covering Liu Bei’s retreat at Changban and participating in the conquest of the Sichuan basin. Promotion under Liu Bei’s new royal and imperial titles made him a senior figure in the emerging Shu state. The same account links his end to the treatment of his own soldiers: Liu Bei warned against excessive punishment, and subordinates killed Zhang Fei before the campaign against Wu in 221. This is a portrait of command that joins courage to an institutional problem—how a general’s authority depended on the people he disciplined.
reviewedSummary.zh: 张飞的传记展现了他与刘备、关羽在长期从军中建立的关系。史书将长坂掩护撤退及参与夺取四川盆地的功劳归于他。刘备称王、称帝时给予的晋升，使张飞成为蜀汉形成过程中的高级将领。同一传记也把他的结局同对士卒的待遇联系起来：刘备曾劝止过度处罚，而部下于221年伐吴前杀死张飞。这幅将领画像把勇气与统率问题放在一起：军官的权力，也取决于他如何对待执行命令的人。

evidence.en: Anonymous Ming-dynasty painting of Zhang Fei, Palace Museum, Beijing.
evidence.zh: 明代佚名张飞像，北京故宫博物院藏。

reviewedTitle.en: Wei Qing · Command, supply and court favor
reviewedTitle.zh: 卫青 · 统兵、供给与宫廷关系

reviewedSummary.en: Wei Qing's rise connected a vulnerable household position with access to the imperial court through his sister Wei Zifu. The Shiji nevertheless traces his authority through repeated commands, particularly the seizure of territory around the Yellow River's northern bend and the large campaign beyond the desert. Those operations required transport, horses and coordination among separate forces. Victory also brought captives, new settlements and rewards that tied military success to the emperor's patronage. The biography records disputes over failed subordinate commanders and contrasts Wei Qing's caution with Huo Qubing's increasing prominence. Together these episodes show command as an institutional and political task, not merely a sequence of personal feats. The map uses broad campaign settings rather than a purported exact marching route.
reviewedSummary.zh: 卫青的崛起，从处境脆弱的家庭成员开始，经由姐姐卫子夫进入皇帝身边。《史记》同时也通过多次统兵说明其权力来源，尤其是夺取黄河北曲一带，以及越过沙漠的大规模远征。这些行动需要运输、马匹和多路部队的协调。胜利又带来俘虏、移民与封赏，把军事成功同皇帝恩遇相联系。传记记述了对失利部将如何处置的争议，也比较卫青的谨慎与霍去病日益上升的地位。这些片段说明，统军既是制度工作，也是政治工作，并非一串个人壮举。地图采用宽泛的战役场景，不声称复原精确行军路线。

reviewedTitle.en: Zhou Yu · Coalition command on the Yangzi
reviewedTitle.zh: 周瑜 · 长江上的联军指挥

reviewedSummary.en: Zhou Yu's command depended on cooperation as well as tactical decisions. A companion of Sun Ce, he later helped sustain Sun Quan's authority. When Cao Cao moved south, Zhou Yu argued that distance, disease and unfamiliar river warfare limited the invading army. At Red Cliffs he served alongside Cheng Pu and allied with Liu Bei; the biography credits Huang Gai with proposing the fire attack. Victory did not finish the campaign. Fighting around Jiangling continued against Cao Ren, and Zhou Yu was wounded before the city changed hands. These linked operations reveal a war of logistics, officers and coalition interests. They also make room for the many participants obscured when the battle is reduced to one brilliant hero.
reviewedSummary.zh: 周瑜的指挥既依靠战术，也依靠合作。他早年与孙策相交，后来支持孙权维持统治。曹操南下时，周瑜指出远距离作战、疾病和不熟悉水战对来军的限制。赤壁之战，他与程普共同统兵，并与刘备合作；列传把提出火攻之计的功劳归给黄盖。胜利没有结束整个战役，在江陵与曹仁的战斗仍持续进行，周瑜受伤后又继续督战，直到城池易手。把这些行动连起来，可以看到粮运、将领和联盟利益共同构成的战争，也让被单一英雄叙事遮蔽的参与者重新出现。

evidence.en: Ma Tai, Setting Fire at Red Cliffs, Ma Tai Hua Bao, 1928. A later image of Zhou Yu’s command.
evidence.zh: 马骀《赤壁纵火》，《马骀画宝》，1928年，后世描绘周瑜统军的图像。

reviewedTitle.en: Lu Xun · Patience, command and coercion
reviewedTitle.zh: 陆逊 · 等待、指挥与强制

reviewedSummary.en: Lu Xun's career connects the expansion of Wu with the demands it placed on local society. His early commands drew people into military service and registered households; the biography even preserves criticism that he took people unjustly. In 219 he helped Lü Meng prepare the seizure of Guan Yu's rear. Against Liu Bei in 222, he resisted impatient colleagues, waited for an opportunity and used fire to break the enemy camps. A further victory over Wei at Shiting strengthened his standing. Military achievement rested on managing fellow commanders and drawing resources from the countryside. This Lu Xun is the third-century general, whose name and historical setting should remain distinct from the modern writer Lu Xun.
reviewedSummary.zh: 陆逊的经历把吴国扩张与地方社会承担的要求联系起来。早期统兵时，他将人口纳入军役和编户，传记甚至保存了他侵取民众的批评。219年，他协助吕蒙准备袭取关羽后方。222年对抗刘备时，他压住将领急战的要求，等待时机，再用火攻击破敌营。后来在石亭击败魏军，又巩固了其地位。军功依赖对同僚的协调，也依赖从乡村取得的资源。此处的陆逊是三世纪将领，姓名的英文拼写虽与现代作家鲁迅相近，人物和时代必须保持区分。

evidence.en: Ma Tai, Burning the Linked Camps, Ma Tai Hua Bao, 1928, depicting the Three Kingdoms commander Lu Xun.
evidence.zh: 马骀《火焚连寨》，《马骀画宝》，1928年，表现三国将领陆逊。

reviewedTitle.en: Huo Qubing · A short career in frontier war
reviewedTitle.zh: 霍去病 · 边疆战争中的短暂生涯

reviewedSummary.en: Huo Qubing's short career was bound to Emperor Wu's expansion and to the military household of his uncle Wei Qing. The Shiji describes a young commander favored with selected cavalry, rapid operations and substantial rewards. Campaigns in the Hexi corridor and beyond the desert helped alter the balance between Han and Xiongnu powers. They also displaced people and depended on supplies, captured resources and costly losses of horses. The historian's portrait includes criticism of the contrast between the commander's privileged provisions and hungry soldiers. After his death, the imperial funeral used a mound resembling the Qilian mountains to turn a campaign landscape into commemoration. His story links military achievement to the choices about what a court chooses to remember.
reviewedSummary.zh: 霍去病短暂的仕途与汉武帝的扩张，以及舅父卫青的军事家庭紧密相连。《史记》描写这位年轻统帅拥有优选骑兵，善于快速行动，并得到丰厚封赏。河西与漠北战役改变了汉与匈奴的力量关系，同时也使人口迁移，并依赖供给、缴获资源和代价高昂的马匹消耗。史家的描写还包含批评：将领享有优厚食物，与士卒饥饿形成反差。他去世后，皇帝以形似祁连山的墓冢纪念，将战役景观转化为追怀形式。其故事把军事成就与宫廷选择如何记忆战争联系起来。

evidence.en: Victor Segalen’s 1914 photograph of the stone horse at Huo Qubing’s tomb; the sculpture dates to the Western Han.
evidence.zh: 谢阁兰1914年摄霍去病墓石马；雕刻属西汉时期。

reviewedTitle.en: Wu Zetian: making a claim to rule
reviewedTitle.zh: 武则天：建立统治的正当性

reviewedSummary.en: Wu Zetian exercised power within the Tang court before taking the imperial title in her own Zhou dynasty in 690. Her career exposes the gendered assumptions built into dynastic rule: women could wield influence, but claiming the emperor’s position required a different public argument. Buddhist patronage, new political symbols and recruitment through examinations helped her build that argument and find supporters beyond established aristocratic circles. Her 674 policy proposals also addressed agriculture and official conduct. This was no general opening of office to women; the examination system remained male. Forced from power in 705, she left a reign whose institutions and reputation need to be distinguished from hostile anecdotes in later histories.
reviewedSummary.zh: 武则天在唐廷掌握权力多年，690年以皇帝身份建立自己的周朝。她的经历显露了王朝统治中的性别门槛：女性可以施加影响，直接占据皇帝之位却需要另行建立公开的正当性。佛教赞助、新的政治象征与科举选才，帮助她寻找既有贵族圈子以外的支持者。674年的建言还涉及农业与官员行为。这并不意味着仕途向女性普遍开放，科举仍由男性参加。705年被迫退位后，她的制度实践与后世充满敌意的轶闻共同流传，阅读时应辨明两者的来源。

evidence.en: Wu Zetian in an eighteenth-century album of 86 imperial portraits, British Library Or 2231.
evidence.zh: 十八世纪八十六帝王像册中的武则天，大英图书馆藏Or 2231。

reviewedTitle.en: Xin Qiji: crossing a political divide, writing across it

reviewedSummary.en: Xin Qiji came from Licheng in the north and entered Southern Song service in 1162. His career crossed a political boundary that remained central to his reputation as a writer. Office in Jiangyin was followed by a Jiankang appointment in 1168, linking literary ambition to the work and frustrations of provincial government. He became known for ci, lyrics composed to established tune patterns, and for the desire to recover the north. Later periods away from active office in Jiangxi formed another setting for his writing. The sequence of appointments is unevenly documented: local research can recover possibilities, but a newly proposed posting should not silently become a certain stop on his map.
reviewedSummary.zh: 辛弃疾来自北方历城，1162年进入南宋仕途。越过政治分界的经历，始终关联着他作为作家的声誉。江阴任职之后，1168年又任建康官职，使文学抱负与地方政务及其挫折相连。他以依词调写作的词著名，也因恢复北方的愿望受到重视。后来在江西离开积极政务的时期，又形成另一种写作背景。任职先后的证据并不均匀：地方考证可以提出新的可能，但新推定的官职地点不应悄悄变成地图上的确定一站。

evidence.zh: 辛弃疾《去国帖》，故宫博物院据官职考定为1175年农历十月。

reviewedTitle.en: Huang Chao · taking a capital, feeding an army
reviewedTitle.zh: 黄巢 · 攻取都城与供应军粮

reviewedSummary.en: Huang Chao joined an uprising that spread during drought and political disorder in the late Tang. After Wang Xianzhi died in 878, he became the rebels’ leading commander. His forces reached Guangzhou before turning north and occupying Chang’an, where he proclaimed a new dynasty. Possessing a capital did not provide a secure state: disrupted cultivation and contested supply lines made provisions a central problem. The Old Tang History also records killings of officials and residents, challenging any account of an uncomplicated popular liberation. Expelled from Chang’an in 883, Huang died the following year. His campaign connects rural distress, mobile armies and the difficulties of governing a city acquired through war.
reviewedSummary.zh: 唐末旱灾与政治失序中，黄巢加入了扩展中的反叛。878年王仙芝死后，他成为起义军主要统帅。其军南至广州，又转向北方，进入长安并建立新政权。然而，占有都城并不等于掌握稳固国家：耕作中断、运输争夺使粮食供应成为要害。《旧唐书》还记载了杀害官员与居民的行为，不能将这段历史写成没有矛盾的民众解放。883年黄巢退出长安，次年死亡。他的战争把农村困境、流动作战与战后治理城市的难题联系起来。

evidence.en: Huang Chao in a late-Ming printed edition of Can Tang Wudai Shi Yanyi Zhuan, preserved in facsimile.
evidence.zh: 晚明刊本《残唐五代史演义传》中的黄巢像，今见影印本。

reviewedTitle.en: Han Shizhong · river defence and the limits of command
reviewedTitle.zh: 韩世忠 · 江防与将权的边界

reviewedSummary.en: Han Shizhong helped restore Emperor Gaozong during the military coup of 1129, then defended the lower Yangtze against Jin forces. The Song History remembers both the pressure his ships placed on the enemy and the eventual Jin escape: the celebrated river campaign was not an uncomplicated annihilating victory. It also gives his wife, Lady Liang, an active role in signalling the fighting. Han opposed the court’s moves toward peace with the Jin. In 1141 his field command was removed, followed by retirement from central military office. He died in 1151. His biography places battlefield initiative beside the political limits imposed on commanders by the government they served.
reviewedSummary.zh: 1129年兵变中，韩世忠参与恢复宋高宗的皇位，随后在长江下游抵御金军。《宋史》既记述其舰船对敌军的压力，也记述金军最终脱身，因此这场著名江上战事并非毫无转折的歼灭性胜利。传记还写到梁夫人亲自击鼓参与指挥。韩世忠反对朝廷与金议和；1141年，他的野战军权被收回，随后退出中央军政职位，1151年去世。他的经历把战场上的主动权，与朝廷对将领权力的限制并置起来。

evidence.zh: 《中兴四将图》中的韩世忠局部，南宋，传刘松年作。

reviewedTitle.en: Yelü Chucai: service across the Jin and Mongol courts
reviewedTitle.zh: 耶律楚材：金与蒙古朝廷之间的仕途

reviewedSummary.en:
A Khitan scholar-official, Yelü Chucai served under the Jin and later under the Mongol rulers Chinggis Khan and Ögedei. His life crossed the fall of Zhongdu, the Mongol campaigns in Central Asia and efforts to organize taxation in northern China. The History of Yuan presents his advice and administrative role from a later court perspective; it should not be read as proof that he acted alone or prevented all violence.

His account of western places offers evidence of Mongol-era knowledge, but a modern study cautions that it is not a complete, stop-by-stop itinerary. The atlas therefore shows selected contexts rather than a reconstructed journey.
reviewedSummary.zh:
契丹士人耶律楚材先后服务于金朝及蒙古统治者成吉思汗、窝阔台。他的人生经历中都陷落、蒙古在中亚的军事行动，以及华北税收制度的整顿。《元史》从后世朝廷视角记述他的建议和行政角色，不能据此认定一切成果由他独力完成，也不能推称他阻止了所有暴行。

他记述西方地域的著作反映蒙古时代的知识；现代研究提醒，这并非逐站完整行程。因此地图只呈现选取的历史背景，不复原行军路线。

evidence.zh: 顾沅《古圣贤像传略》卷12中的耶律楚材像，数字页3，1830年。

reviewedTitle.en: Qi Jiguang: recruiting, training and adapting an army
reviewedTitle.zh: 戚继光：募兵、操练与军队调整

reviewedSummary.en: Qi Jiguang’s military career connects coastal raiding with the practical work of building a fighting force. Assigned to Zhejiang in 1555, he recruited men from Yiwu in 1559 and organized mixed-weapon formations whose members had to act together. Fighting around Taizhou in 1561 tested that preparation. His later northern command, beginning in 1568, brought different conditions: frontier fortifications and coordination among infantry, cavalry, firearms and wagons. Support from Zhang Juzheng helped sustain this work, while the political changes after Zhang’s death preceded Qi’s transfer to Guangdong in 1583. Training manuals and defenses belong beside battles in this biography, because the effectiveness of an army depended on repeated practice, organization and material support.
reviewedSummary.zh: 戚继光的军事生涯，把沿海袭扰与建立作战力量的具体工作联系起来。1555年到浙江任职，1559年在义乌募兵，并组织需要成员协同的多兵器阵形。1561年台州地区的战事检验了这些准备。1568年开始的北方任职又面对不同条件，包括边防工事，以及步兵、骑兵、火器和战车的配合。张居正的支持有助于维持工作，张氏死后的政治变化则先于1583年戚氏调往广东。兵书与防御工程应与战役并列，因为军队的能力有赖反复操练、组织和物资保障。

evidence.zh: 《纪效新书》卷一开篇，页上署戚继光撰；日本1798年刊本。

reviewedTitle.en: Zheng Chenggong · a Ming loyalist across the strait
reviewedTitle.zh: 郑成功 · 跨海的明朝效忠者

reviewedSummary.en: Zheng Chenggong built his resistance to Qing rule around coastal strongholds rather than an inland capital. Xiamen and Kinmen became bases in 1650; from this maritime setting he carried the Ming loyalist struggle into Taiwan. His forces landed there in 1661 and challenged the Dutch colonial government. The episode survives in competing memories: a Japanese memorial museum follows his cross-border family history, while the former Dutch governor Frederick Coyett later published a defence of his own conduct. Zheng died in Taiwan in 1662. Reading these accounts together reveals how a military campaign became a story repeatedly retold by communities on different shores.
reviewedSummary.zh: 郑成功的抗清事业以沿海据点为依托。1650年，厦门与金门成为他的基地；他随后把效忠明朝的战争带到台湾，军队于1661年登陆，与荷兰殖民当局作战。这段经历留下了不同立场的叙述：日本的纪念馆着重介绍他的跨海家世，荷兰末任台湾长官揆一则在事后出版著作为自身辩护。郑成功于1662年在台湾去世。将这些材料并读，可以看见一场战争如何成为海峡两岸及海外社群不断重述的历史。

evidence.en: Anonymous seventeenth-century portrait of Zheng Chenggong, held by the National Taiwan Museum.
evidence.zh: 十七世纪佚名郑成功像，国立台湾博物馆藏。

reviewedTitle.en: Sun Yat-sen · revolution through overseas networks
reviewedTitle.zh: 孙中山 · 海外网络中的革命

reviewedSummary.en: Sun Yat-sen’s revolution depended on people and money moving between places. The Revive China Society, founded in Honolulu in 1894, and the Revolutionary Alliance formed in Tokyo in 1905 connected overseas supporters, students and activists. Publications, donations and bonds helped sustain a campaign repeatedly interrupted by failed uprisings. Sun became provisional president at Nanjing in January 1912 and soon relinquished the office during negotiations with Yuan Shikai. The republic remained contested. In Guangzhou, Sun continued trying to build a political and military base; the Whampoa Military Academy opened in 1924 with Soviet and Chinese Communist assistance. His career makes overseas organizing central to the history of the Chinese republic.
reviewedSummary.zh: 孙中山的革命依靠人员和资金在不同地点之间流动。1894年成立于檀香山的兴中会，以及1905年在东京成立的同盟会，把海外支持者、学生和活动家联系起来。报刊、捐款与债券支撑了屡遭起义失败打击的事业。1912年1月，孙中山在南京就任临时大总统，不久在与袁世凯的协商中交出职位。共和国的制度与权力仍受到争夺。此后，他在广州继续建立政治和军事基础，1924年黄埔军校在苏联及中国共产党协助下开办。他的经历说明，海外组织活动是中国共和历史的重要组成部分。

evidence.zh: 1922年11月15日，孙中山摄于上海波尔照相馆。

reviewedTitle.en: Chiang Kai-shek · military power and authoritarian rule
reviewedTitle.zh: 蒋介石 · 军事权力与威权统治

reviewedSummary.en: Chiang Kai-shek’s power grew from the military institutions of the Nationalist revolution. Commandant of Whampoa in 1924, he led the Northern Expedition from 1926 and later headed the Nationalist government. War against Japan and the renewed civil war reshaped his rule. After military defeat and the government’s relocation to Taiwan in 1949, he resumed the presidency in Taipei in 1950. Official chronologies emphasize state building; Taiwan’s National Human Rights Museum documents the coercive machinery behind authoritarian rule, including military trials of civilians and Chiang’s intervention in sentences. Holding these records together connects the commander’s political survival with the experiences of people persecuted under his government.
reviewedSummary.zh: 蒋介石的权力从国民革命的军事制度中成长。1924年出任黄埔军校校长后，他于1926年领导北伐，后来主持国民政府。对日战争与再次爆发的国共内战改变了他的统治。1949年军事失败、政府迁台后，他于1950年在台北恢复总统职务。官方年表强调国家建设，台湾国家人权博物馆则记录威权统治的强制机制，包括以军事审判处理平民，以及蒋介石亲自干预刑期。将这些材料并读，可以把军事领导人的政治延续与其政府之下遭受迫害者的经历联系起来。

reviewedTitle.en: Mao Zedong · revolution, state and mass campaigns

reviewedSummary.en: Mao Zedong moved from revolutionary organizer and guerrilla commander to chairman of the Communist Party’s Politburo in 1943. After the establishment of the People’s Republic in 1949, he and his colleagues transformed landholding, industry and everyday political life. These changes expanded state power while campaigns imposed severe human costs. The Great Leap Forward brought catastrophic suffering; conflict within the leadership then fed into the Cultural Revolution, launched in 1966. Mao encouraged mass mobilization and a personal cult that helped turn political disagreements into persecution. His death in 1976 closed this phase of personal rule. Understanding his career requires examining both revolutionary institution building and the people harmed by the state’s campaigns.
reviewedSummary.zh: 毛泽东从革命组织者和游击战争指挥者逐步成为中共领导人，1943年出任中央政治局主席。1949年中华人民共和国成立后，他与同僚推动土地制度、工业和日常政治生活的改造。这些变化扩大了国家权力，政治运动也造成沉重的人道代价。大跃进带来灾难性苦难，领导层的冲突随后卷入1966年发动的文化大革命。毛泽东鼓励群众动员，个人崇拜又使政治分歧转化为迫害。1976年他的去世结束了这一阶段的个人统治。理解他的生涯，需要同时考察革命建制与国家运动中受害者的经历。

reviewedTitle.en: Deng Xiaoping · market reform and political limits
reviewedTitle.zh: 邓小平 · 市场改革与政治边界

reviewedSummary.en: Deng Xiaoping’s post-Mao authority rested on decades inside the Communist Party, including service as general secretary from 1956. Purged during the Cultural Revolution and restored to senior office, he emerged as China’s effective leader by the end of 1978. Economic reform widened the role of markets and incentives and changed daily livelihoods. Political power, however, remained under party control. Deng opposed liberalization that threatened that control and supported the military suppression of the 1989 democracy movement. His career brings two developments into the same frame: changes that increased economic opportunity and a leadership willing to use armed force against political dissent. Neither can be separated from the history of the reform period.
reviewedSummary.zh: 邓小平在毛泽东之后取得的权威，建立在数十年的中共资历之上，其中包括1956年起担任中央总书记。文革中被打倒、随后重返高层后，他到1978年底成为实际最高领导人。经济改革扩大了市场与激励的作用，改变了日常生计；政治权力则继续由党掌握。邓小平反对威胁这一控制的政治自由化，并支持1989年以军队镇压民主运动。他的生涯同时呈现两种发展：经济机会的扩大，以及领导层用武力压制政治异议的选择。两者都属于改革时期的历史。

reviewedTitle.en: Tu Youyou: research, collaboration and recognition
reviewedTitle.zh: 屠呦呦：研究、协作与认可

reviewedSummary.en:
Tu Youyou’s research connected pharmaceutical training, historical medical texts and experimental work on malaria. In 1969 she took a leading role in a research group within the wider Project 523 effort. Examining older descriptions of qinghao informed questions about preparation, but the identification of artemisinin also required extraction, testing, chemical work and collaboration across institutions. A traditional reference was a research lead, not by itself proof of a compound’s properties.

The 2015 Nobel Prize recognized her contribution to the discovery. That recognition should be placed beside the collective and institutional history of the research, rather than erasing either individual initiative or the work of colleagues. This entry follows a research career to an award, without treating that award as the end of her life. Her story brings women’s scientific labour and twentieth-century institutions into a history that crossed national boundaries through later recognition and discussion.
reviewedSummary.zh:
屠呦呦的研究把药学训练、历史医籍与疟疾实验联系起来。1969年，她在更广泛的“523”科研工作中担任研究组负责人。对古代青蒿记载的考察，为制备方法提出问题；但青蒿素的发现仍需要提取、实验检验、化学研究和跨机构合作。传统文献提供的是研究线索，并不单独构成对化合物性质的证明。

2015年诺贝尔奖表彰了她对这一发现的贡献。理解这一认可，需要同时保留个人主动性和同事、机构共同工作的历史。本条追踪科研活动至获奖，并不把获奖当作生命终点。她的经历使女性科研劳动与二十世纪的制度进入历史叙述；后续的认可和讨论，又让这一历史跨越国界。

reviewedTitle.en: Wu Zhou: Wu Zetian’s interruption of Tang rule
reviewedTitle.zh: 武周：武则天与唐统的中断

reviewedSummary.en:
Wu Zetian founded her own Zhou dynasty after exercising power during the reigns of Tang emperors. Her reign as emperor from 690 to 705 interrupts the usual Tang 618–907 bar. A readable dynasty timeline can preserve Tang as a broader historical frame while making this change of ruling house visible.

The episode also connects political authority with textual memory. The Chinese University of Hong Kong notes that her collected works no longer survive as a complete collection, while poems and essays remain in later Tang anthologies. That distinction matters: the survival of later compilations is different from possessing an author’s original collection. This entry follows the dynasty and its evidence, not a reconstructed travel itinerary or a claim that every frontier changed in 690.
reviewedSummary.zh:
武则天在唐帝在位期间掌握权力，继而建立自己的周朝。690—705年的称帝时段，构成通常“唐618—907年”这一长条中的统治家族变化。可读的朝代时间线应保留唐的大历史框架，同时让武周的中断可见。

这一事件也涉及政治权威与文本保存。香港中文大学资料指出，她的作品集《垂拱集》已佚，部分诗文仍保存在后来的唐代总集中。“后世汇编仍存”与“拥有作者原集”是不同的证据状态。本条关注王朝和史料，不重建个人旅行路线，也不主张690年所有边界随之改变。
